scope: arbitrary finite simple hosts, all s,t>=3, red=(2^(s-1),1), blue=(2^t) or (2^(t-1),1)
unbounded_proof: Degree-two path/cycle decomposition gives explicit avoiding colour for subcanonical edge-budget graphs. Alternate colouring odd cycles gives one selectable P3 exception; boundary maximal odd-cycle count forces all triangles+<=1 or<=2 exterior edges, or one C5 for both-tail case. Colour entire triangles and C5 to avoid required additional disjoint K2. Therefore a subcanonical arrowing host must have degree>=3. Base s=3 all t uses pinned published two-component exact theorem; delete high-degree vertex to induct sharp joint in s, then original from degree gate and sharp joint in any G-v.
